correctness.rationale: The explicit family is exactly (2d-1)-separable, and two incompatible d-cover violations prove that no single appended row can make it d-disjunct; two singleton rows suffice. Combined with fixed-size separability monotonicity and the Chen--Hwang 2d-to-d theorem, this yields G(s)=floor(s/2) for every s>=2.

originality.rationale: The 2007 Chen--Hwang theorem gives the exact-2d one-row conversion, and later literature located through 2026 restates or error-tolerantly extends that connection without a sharpness family or exact worst-case frontier. Searches across separable/union-free and disjunct/cover-free/superimposed terminology found no equivalent result. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result determines the exact universal disjunctness parameter achievable by one-row augmentation from exact separability of arbitrary order, closing the natural quantitative sharpness question for the Chen--Hwang link.
